crossRefs.note: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t…
Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will…
We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.
Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…
Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent…
because an excellent spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpreting of dreams, showing of dark sentences, and…
The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
